version.description: Take the leap into Moonpetal Marsh! Guide Fred through a 100-level touch-first adventure filled with lily pads, bugs, currents and marsh predators. Leap over danger, dive beneath surface hunters, munch nearby bugs and boost toward the Moonpetal Exit. Earn coins to unlock frog colors and hero gear, and watch for a helpful fairy every tenth level. Find the hidden Golden Egg and choose whether to share your Game Center player name on the website's hunt leaderboard, then return to the beginning of Level 5. Includes reduced-motion support and no advertising or in-app purchases.
version.promotional_text: Leap, dive, munch and boost through a moonlit marsh as Fred becomes the frog hero every little frog dreams about.
version.whats_new: Fred's marsh adventure is smoother than ever! The Game Center leaderboard now opens cleanly, shows the signed-in player identity, and returns you to the title when you tap Home. We've also tightened touch recovery after closing Game Center while keeping Pause, saves, music and the full 100-level journey intact.
version.review_notes: Touch the playfield to steer; use MUNCH, LEAP, BOOST, DIVE/SURFACE and PAUSE. EXIT returns to the title. A fairy appears every tenth level. The optional Golden Egg flow uses Game Center authentication, offers Public, Anonymous and Don't Post choices, and opens the Hunt website only after an explicit posting choice. Returning from the reveal starts Level 5 again. No advertising or in-app purchases. Exact-build Game Center authentication and the complete Golden Egg return flow remain listed for physical-device acceptance in TestFlight.
version.beta_description: Build 13 repairs the standard native Game Center leaderboard flow: the signed-in player identity is displayed, sign-in intent continues into the leaderboard, duplicate presentation is blocked, native dismissal clears held touches, and Home returns to the title. Pause, saves, audio, offline play and existing marsh gameplay remain unchanged. Golden Egg website defects remain outside this repair and are still deferred by the owner.
what_to_test: Fresh and upgrade launch without losing saves or cosmetics
From the title, tap LEADERBOARD while signed out; complete Game Center sign-in and confirm the native leaderboard opens without a second tap
Confirm the title shows the provider-reported Game Center player name after sign-in
Dismiss the native leaderboard, then tap Home and confirm the title is immediately interactive
Repeatedly open and close the leaderboard; no duplicate controller, freeze, stuck overlay or held-touch movement
Pause, background and foreground with touch held
Game Center score submission and leaderboard display using the existing Fred leaderboard ID
Zero website requests during launch, menu, play, saves, Game Center sign-in/native leaderboards and foreground
The title contains no Licenses button or legal-notice modal
Gameplay, audio and offline play on iPhone and iPad
